name: Trade Embargo
description: No trade routes or deals with the target civilization.

name: Luxury Ban
description: The chosen luxury gives no happiness anywhere.

name: Faith of the World
description: The founder of the religion gets +2 delegates; its holy city +3 culture.

name: Doctrine of the World
description: Civilizations following the ideology get +1 delegate and +2 happiness.

name: Patronage of the Arts
description: +25% great artist, writer and musician points everywhere.

name: Scholars Abroad
description: +10% science in every city of every civilization.

name: Atomic Accord
description: Nuclear weapons can no longer be built or used.

name: World Fair
description: An international project: whoever contributes most production gets a free policy; every contributor gets culture.
